referenceSources.title: 1992 PEUGEOT 309 1.9 GTI | Sat 5th & Sun 6th April  | Anglia Car Auctions
referenceSources.description:
A vibrant red 1992 Peugeot 309 1.9 GTI is displayed inside an auction hall, framed by blue steel supports and a brick wall bearing the ACA logo. The hatchback’s alloy wheels, black side trim, and sunroof are clearly visible, while overhead signs mark the office and auction notices. The car’s condition reflects its 121,500 miles, with minor wear on the trim and tires.

Auction details from Anglia Car Auctions list this vehicle as Lot 339, sold for £5,724 including premium against an estimate of £2,750–£3,750. The listing notes a V5 document, chassis number VF33CDKZ210542072, and a 1905cc engine. Stored dry from 2010 until late 2024, the GTI requires MoT work on brakes, driveshaft gaiter, and other components. Upgrades include a stainless manifold, Magnex exhaust, Sparco strut brace, and K&N filter, with paperwork and spares included.
